title: Alexander Colón, Wichita Area Real Estate Agent
description: Straight answers about buying and selling in Wichita, Maize, Derby, Andover, Goddard, Park City, and Rose Hill. Ask a question before you commit to anything.
h1: Real estate decisions should come with clear information.
job: Sort the visitor into the lane that fits them, and answer enough of their question that contacting Alex is the obvious next step.
primaryPrinciple: Reciprocity. The give comes before the ask.

bands.headline: Real estate decisions should come with clear information.
bands.support: Buying, selling, or investing involves a lot of moving pieces. Alex helps you understand the numbers, the process, and your options so you can make informed decisions with confidence.
bands.attribution: Alexander Colón, agent with At Home Wichita Real Estate.

portrait.needed: Supplied. Kept here as the record of what was asked for: a background-removed portrait PNG at 2x, with its pixel width and height recorded so the frame reserves the right box and nothing shifts.
portrait.source: Supplied by Alex Colón, September 2026. Delivered as a 2000x2000 RGBA PNG with the background already removed; file metadata records it as prepared in Canva by Garrett Von Flue. Measured on arrival rather than assumed: the alpha channel is real (54.7 percent of pixels fully transparent, 0.97 percent partial), the subject's bounding box is x 15 to 1999 by y 250 to 1999, and the matte carries no light halo (edge pixels average 4.9 luminance units darker than the opaque pixel beside them, not brighter).

bands.heading: Run the numbers
body: Three calculators in one place: what a monthly payment buys, what a seller walks away with, and what a rental actually returns. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is stored.

bands.heading: Where do you want to start?

items.q: How do I know what I can afford?
items.a: Start with the calculator above. Put in the monthly payment you want to stay under and it works backward to roughly what price that supports, including an estimate of the cash you would need at closing. The Buy page walks through the rest of the process.

items.q: How do I find out what my home could sell for?
items.a: The Sell page explains how value is actually determined, and has a calculator for what you would walk away with after payoff, compensation and closing costs. If you want a number on your specific address, ask Alex to review it.

items.q: Can you help with a VA loan?
items.a: Yes. Alex served eleven years on active duty in the Air Force and has used the benefit himself. The Veterans page covers the main differences between a VA purchase and a conventional one, with links to the official VA.gov sources.

items.q: Can you help me analyze a rental property?
items.a: The Investors page has a long-term rental calculator that works through cash flow, NOI and cash-on-cash return. Alex owns rental property himself, so on a specific address he can look at it as an owner as well as an agent.

items.q: I just have a real estate question.
items.a: Ask Lark, the assistant in the bottom-right corner. It answers questions about buying and selling around Wichita, says so when it does not know something, and hands you to Alex whenever you would rather have a person.
